summary: The 8BitDo Retro Mechanical Keyboard is on sale. It offers unique retro styling with dual Super Buttons. Get it for $69.99, one of its lowest prices ever.

headline: Cats and dogs are missing meals after a popular smart feeder went down
summary: A Petlibro outage is impacting smart pet feeders. Devices like feeders, litter boxes, and water fountains are offline. Pets are missing scheduled meals due to the disruption.

headline: The next big indie game publisher is taking some exciting swings
summary: Kinetic Publishing, from the Phasmophobia team, held its first showcase. Five ambitious new indie titles are slated for 2027-2028 release. They are also publishing the next game from 'Telling Lies' creator.

headline: Here's Where to Stream Every Minions Movie Online Right Now
summary: Find out where to stream all Minions movies. A comprehensive guide for the animated franchise is available. Catch up on the beloved Minions saga from home.

headline: McDonald's Announces Eight Hello Kitty x Godzilla Toys Coming to Happy Meals This August
summary: McDonald's is launching a Hello Kitty x Godzilla Happy Meal collaboration. Eight unique toys will be available starting this August. This highly-anticipated partnership promises collectibles for fans.

headline: Made by Google 2026: Everything Announced
summary: Google's annual Made By Google event revealed new flagship hardware. The Pixel 11 was a major highlight of the announcements. The keynote also featured several surprises and product updates.

headline: Old School Runescape Officially Recognizes Player Who Reached Level 99 Fishing Catching Only Shrimp and Anchovies
summary: An OSRS player achieved Level 99 Fishing with an unconventional method. They exclusively caught shrimp and anchovies for the entire grind. The official Old School Runescape X account recognized this unique feat.

headline: Once-in-a-generation solar eclipse wows millions in UK and Europe
summary: A rare solar eclipse captivated millions across the UK and Europe. Over 95% of the Sun was obscured in parts of Cornwall. Parts of Spain experienced the complete spectacle of a total eclipse.

headline: Major Russian grain export terminals hit in Ukraine Black Sea port attack
summary: Russian grain export terminals were struck in a Black Sea port attack. Grain exports from both Russia and Ukraine are now falling. Attacks are targeting vital shipping facilities and ports.

headline: Students wait for A-level, T-level and BTec results
summary: Students across the UK are awaiting A-level, T-level, and BTec results. A record number are projected to secure their first-choice university. Results day marks a crucial step for many academic futures.

headline: Burnham urges shops not to sell disposable BBQs over wildfire risks
summary: The PM urges shops to halt sales of disposable BBQs. This measure aims to prevent dangerous wildfires. The call comes during a period of extremely dry weather.
